description: This file contains the implementation of the Category model class within the Opencart catalog module. It defines methods for retrieving category data, filters, layout IDs, and associated functionalities. The class extends a system engine Model and interacts with a database for data retrieval.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents the catalog category model, providing methods to retrieve category details, list categories, filters, and layout IDs from the database.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific category by its ID, including description and store data.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories with a specified parent ID, typically used for listing subcategories.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Fetches filters associated with a specific category, including filter groups and filter options.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID associated with the specified category, used to determine display layout.
